verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is an iOS terminal with a built-in local command set, so shipping git tooling is a fair question for this kind of product. However, its documented local commands (cat, grep, ls, cp, curl, scp, sftp and similar) include no git, and nothing in the pack shows amending or undoing commits. Running git on a remote host over SSH/Mosh, or through a connected VS Code server, is a host-side workaround and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can amend the latest commit or undo unpushed commits to fix or split them
